messages:
Ana: Quick heads-up — we're putting together customer-facing updates for the partial inference outage earlier. Need alignment on status page wording + customer email timing. @Sam can you advise on support load? @Liam can you confirm scope?

DevOps-Bot: Incident detected: routing congestion on eu-west-1 inference cluster. Started 1994000000. Current status: investigating. https://redwood.statuspage.io/incident/1994

Sam: Support seeing a spike in tickets (~40). Customers asking 'is data affected?' Most we can reassure it's runtime-only. Recommend statuspage ack ASAP; short email only if we hit 2+ hours or sustained degradation. :raising_hand:

Liam: Product: root cause looks like autoscaler mis-scheduling + a buggy GPU driver combo; should know more in 30–45m. No sign of data exposure so far. Plan to share a brief technical update once confirmed. For now: avoid deep technical claims.

Nora: CS: For inbound leads, pause automated SQL lead routing to SDRs for impacted orgs (eu cluster customers). Route those to a 'high-touch' queue so sales can triage. I can flip the routing in HubSpot if we have the org list.

Ana: Draft statuspage copy (short):

Ana: 'We are investigating increased latency for inference requests in eu-west-1. Some customers may experience errors or timeouts. Our team is investigating and will provide updates here every 30 minutes. There is no evidence of data exposure at this time.'

Maria: Legal: wording mostly fine but please change 'Our team is investigating and will provide updates' -> 'We are investigating and will provide updates'. Avoid implying timelines. Also change 'no evidence of data exposure' to 'There is no evidence of data exposure at this time.'

Ana: Updated draft per legal:

Ana: 'We are investigating increased latency for inference requests in eu-west-1. Some customers may experience errors or timeouts. We are investigating and will provide updates here every 30 minutes. There is no evidence of data exposure at this time.'

Liam: Agree. Add link to support contact and the incident page. Also list affected services: Hosted API — inference.

Ana: Email copy (short alert to paid customers after 2 hours if issue persists):

Ana: 'We experienced increased inference latency affecting eu-west-1 beginning at 08:12 (UTC). Our team is investigating and monitoring the situation. We will follow up with a root-cause summary once available. If you're seeing production impact, please reply to this message or open a ticket at support@redwood.ai. We will notify you of any material service impact.'

Nora: Timing plan: ack on status page now (Ana — can you publish?), update at +30m with progress. If still degraded at +2h we send the email. SDR routing: I'll pause automated routing for orgs with eu-west tenancy — need the org list from infra.

Sam: Support can field incoming emails. I'll prepare a canned reply: short ack + link to status page + instructions to open a ticket. ETA for canned reply 10m.

Ana: Assigning follow-ups: Sam — canned reply; Nora — routing changes; Liam — technical update once RCA; Maria — legal signoff on final email. I'll post the initial ack in 2 mins. :rocket:

DevOps-Bot: Update: autoscaler orchestration logs show OOM on a pod set. Engineers investigating driver rollback. Next update in ~30m.

Sam: Got it. Support will tag high-priority tickets and escalate if volume >100.

Oliver: CS note: Pause webinar onboarding emails for tomorrow's webinar to avoid confusing customers. Marketing ops — please pause scheduled sends for eu-west segments. Who can toggle?

Ana: Marketing ops: @Alex — can you confirm pause on scheduled sends for eu-west lists? If not available, I'll pause via campaign manager in 5.

Alex: On it — paused all scheduled sends to eu-west segments and paused the NPS drip for that cohort. Confirmed.

Ana: Thanks everyone. Posting the status page ack now and will share the link here.
